verdict: No open implementation blockers within the public loading/read/recovery website integration scope. Publication remains gated on the current HTML signature.

resolved.issue: Calling loadObjects on every prepare could redispatch the same uncertain original control when native outcome custody was absent. Stable key/attempt alone only protected retained-outcome replay.
resolved.resolution: A strict atomic IndexedDB intent records exact original load input/control before first native load dispatch. Only the first committed journal admission calls loadObjects; all later callers use recoverLoad. Unresolved absence and all other unsuccessful native results never fall through to a new load.
resolved.proof: Fourteen independent actual Chromium Worker/IndexedDB controls include unknown followed by a new worker, missing recovery/no writes, strict completion ordering, quota/abort/relaxed failures and concurrent admission. The full actual-provider website verifier additionally injects interruption after journal admission but before first native load and observes unresolved recovery after reload.

resolved.issue: Initial verifier dropped acknowledgement of a second prepare (recovery) while claiming initial load acknowledgement-loss coverage.
resolved.resolution: Drop enabled before the first actual prepare/load; expected original creation receipt captured from suppressed response; reload recovers exact original receipt and rows.
resolved.proof: Reviewer independently ran the corrected original verifier unchanged in a temporary fixture against current built assets. Receipt matches the parent result and all 20 hashes exactly.

boundaryConclusions: The only load input is the exact fixed source-retained four-row Products input, with permanent request key and attempt. Worker messages cannot substitute load values, target, source or identifiers.

Only the first committed host admission may call public loadObjects. Reopen/retry routes through public recoverLoad with the unchanged original input/control; no reset, reseed, key rotation or absent-outcome write fallback exists.

Returned native failure/refusal/conflict/unknown/unresolved carriers are kept complete for display. Page detaches on unavailable bootstrap; no public read or successful preparation is reported from an unsuccessful load.
Successful preparation displays values returned by original public readObjects. Independent control supplies changed stored values to prove source seed values are not substituted or reset.

Original action/read/owner capabilities remain worker-local and are freshly issued per open. All writes use the original public Truss API; no administrative SQL or fixture-only population route is introduced.

Actual website proof loads four objects, preserves exact creation receipts/data across first-acknowledgement loss and reopen, then selects three actual rows with full-first batches [2,1]. Existing seal journal, quota-before-dispatch and existing-tab recovery controls pass.
Historical native compiler inputs and current local model/preparation cohort remain unchanged.
scopeLimits: The independent 14-case worker harness uses explicit synthetic provider responses; it establishes host admission/custody behavior, not Truss effect semantics. Separate independent full-site Chromium execution uses the actual original provider.
No physical power-loss/storage eviction/general restore or arbitrary browser qualification is inferred.
Provider keyed submit APIs are bundled but not exposed by the website command surface. Job claiming, UPDATE effects, terminal batch outcomes/replay and full mutating E2E remain outstanding.
No deployment or all-story completion is claimed.
